messages:
sai (release): Quick heads up — we're about to push the delta-only installer (manifest v2026-03-delta-07) to the private transport today during the 17:00 UTC window. Need final sign-off on cosign key and on the transport checksum TTL.

rachel (packaging): building now. delta bundle size ~48MB. will run cosign sign + generate submanifest. planning to publish signed submanifest to offsite mirror after I get the KMS wrap done.

kevin (sre): any regression gates for the canary? we should define explicit SLA/metric triggers for automatic rollback.

jordan (eng): propose canary = 5 hosts in prod-customer-vpc for 30 minutes. rollback if: error-rate >= 3% sustained for 5m OR 95p latency > 500ms OR installer-run failures >= 2.

deploy-bot: /deploy manifest v2026-03-delta-07 --target private-transport --canary 5 --window "2026-03-15T17:00Z/2026-03-15T17:30Z"

deploy-bot: canary started: 5/5 hosts allocated. streaming logs -> https://deploy.logs/2891239999/canary

rachel (packaging): cosign signature: sha256:fa3b2d.... attached to submanifest. submanifest sha256: 0b9c7e... I also included delta.patch metadata with base-version: v2026-02-21-full-12.

kevin (sre): noted. please publish the cosign public key fingerprint here so onprem ops can validate before pulling.

rachel (packaging): cosign pubkey fingerprint: COSIGN:SHA256:7F:2A:9C:... (truncated). vendor-ops, can you confirm validator will accept this key?

vendor-ops: Confirmed, yes. We'll add to allowed-keys in the onprem keyring during the preflight.

jordan (eng): tiny gotcha: the delta installer assumes the destination already has base image tag pinned to rr/v2026-02-21-full-12. If any site drifted we must abort. Add a preflight check: 
```
# preflight check
sha256sum /opt/redwood/images/base.img | grep 3fa1b2c
```

kevin (sre): good. add that to the deploy-bot preflight hook. if check fails, deploy-bot should mark canary as FAILED and pause the window.

deploy-bot: preflight results: 5/5 hosts passed base image checksum. proceeding to patch apply.

mirror-bot: transport upload complete to offsite-mirror-02. 3 replicas healthy. checksums: 0b9c7e... verified.

rachel (packaging): one more thing — we've included a remediation installer fallback named fallback-installer-v2 that can force a full reinstall if delta apply fails. it's signed with the same cosign key.

vendor-ops: reminder — onprem operators will perform an extra validation step: validate KMS-wrapped cosign envelope before download. that step adds ~90s to each host preflight. ok for the window?

sai (release): yes that's fine, we've budgeted 15m of padding.

jordan (eng): metrics during canary: apply success 5/5, average apply time 120s, errors 0. No latency regressions in API path.

kevin (sre): watching. but I see the 95p latency jump to 480ms for a short burst at 17:07 — still under threshold. continuing monitor.

deploy-bot: canary completed successfully at 17:28 UTC. promoting to 50% per rollout plan (staged by region).

rachel (packaging): publishing release notes snippet for this batch: [Private] delta patch v2026-03-delta-07: fixes KV cache hot-reload bug in runtime, reduces cold-start tokenization overhead, small image size reduction. installer: delta-only patch, requires base v2026-02-21-full-12. Signed submanifest and cosign key fingerprint included.

sai (release): thumbs up. one ask: add a short note in the release notes about the preflight checksum and fallback-installer usage so customer ops can triage quickly.

rachel (packaging): done and pushed to docs/release-notes/private/2026-03-delta-07.md

vendor-ops: during region rollout we hit one site where preflight failed (base image checksum mismatch). deploy-bot paused that region. requesting guidance: rebase base image or push full installer?

jordan (eng): if they can update base image to the pinned hash quickly, let them. otherwise push full installer flagged as secure-full v2026-03-full-01 and run remote reinstall using fallback-installer. prefer to avoid full reinstall unless necessary.

vendor-ops: customer chose to rebase to pinned base. completed at 19:10 UTC. resumed rollout for that region.

kevin (sre): final: post-rollout check in 2 hours for error/latency regressions. auto-rollback window remains until 21:00 UTC. If anything crosses thresholds open an incident and tag #incidents.

sai (release): thanks team. I'll file a short postmortem checklist in case we need it: checksum drift detection automation, quicker pubkey distribution for partners, and an emergency channel for fallback-installer ops.

jordan (eng): also capturing the deploy-bot command used in the run for audit: 
```
/deploy manifest v2026-03-delta-07 --target private-transport --canary 5 --promote-stages 5,50,100 --window "2026-03-15T17:00Z/2026-03-15T21:00Z"
```

rachel (packaging): archived signed artifacts to s3://redwood-private-releases/2026-03-delta-07/ (cosign sigs and submanifest). checksums and cosign outputs in the archive.

deploy-bot: rollout complete: 100% hosts. no rollback triggered. closing thread. :white_check_mark:
